title: A Dataset Independent Set of Baselines for Relation Prediction in Argument Mining
reasoning: Although some datasets used in the study contain arguments on topics related to religion (e.g., ComArg dataset) and ethics (e.g., UKP dataset on abortion and death penalty), the paper's objective is to benchmark the structural task of relation prediction (support/attack) between text segments. It does not evaluate the models' understanding, stance, or reasoning about the religious or ethical content itself.
